name: Dura-Ace rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 189 g for the original RD-7400 SIS rear derailleur, stated in Shimano SI-N-71 and the January 1985 New Dura-Ace brochure.

technical_document.title: Shimano RD-7400 exploded view and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano RD-7400 exploded view and replacement parts
Shimano RD-7400 service instruction SI-N-71: 189 g and all four capacity limits
Shimano New Dura-Ace brochure, January 1985, scan 6: original 7400 specifications and weights (archived by Disraeli Gears)

specifications.capacity_note: The brochure gives a 26T maximum combined front-and-rear sprocket difference: total capacity. The separate 13T front chainring difference limit comes from Shimano SI-N-71.
